body:
I agree, adding to this and being more specific with more decimal places, the 1.0-3 config should yield the same result as providing no config (based on the docs).

`{{.11111111|percent}} - {{.11111111|percent:'1.0-3'}}`

Instead displays as

`11% - 11.111%`

It seems like the PercentPipe documentation could be a copy paste issue from the DecimalPipe

[DecimalPipe](https://github.com/angular/angular/blame/7.0.4/packages/common/src/pipes/number_pipe.ts#L50-L68)

[PercentPipe](https://github.com/angular/angular/blame/7.0.4/packages/common/src/pipes/number_pipe.ts#L103-L122)

I cannot recall the PercentPipe ever showing out to three decimal places, does anyone else?


I'd be happy to do the fix PR if this is a documentation fix-

issue.body:
# 📚 Docs or angular.io bug report ### Description The currency pipe's documentation says the maxFractionDigits defaults to 3, but it looks like this defaults to 2. It also says the minFractionDigits default is 0, but it looks like it should be 2. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction ### What's the affected URL?** https://angular.io/api/common/CurrencyPipe ### Reproduction Steps** [This StackBlitz](https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-currency-pipe-default) shows the default vs hardcoding what is in the docs for digitsInfo. ```

{{ 111.11111 | currency }}

{{ 111.11111 | currency:'USD':true:'1.0-3' }}

{{ 111 | currency }}

{{ 111 | currency:'USD':true:'1.0-3' }}

``` ### Expected vs Actual Behavior** The docs should reflect the actual default. ### Anything else relevant? This was noticed after #27079 or else I would have addressed it with that issue, but it's the same type of issue. **Edits Expanded to include minFractionDigits **Edits 2 [The tests](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/packages/common/test/pipes/number_pipe_spec.ts#L82-L102) already cover the defaults, so the future PR will not add any.
